Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: benben000000
Message:
EYG Tire & Auto Care — production site and stock system

A marketing and booking site for a tyre and auto-care shop in Balanga City,
Bataan, plus a stock system wired into the booking lifecycle.

SITE
- 11 pages: home, services and pricing, booking, promotions, contact/location
- High-converting CTAs: sticky header, mobile persistent Call + WhatsApp bar,
  emergency roadside banner, per-service "Select X & Pick Date"
- Local SEO hub with live open status; each business fact tagged
  [CONFIRMED] / [UNVERIFIED] / [CONTRADICTED] at its definition

STOCK SYSTEM
The invariant: available = onHand - reserved, and it is never negative.
Overselling the last oil filter means a customer drives to Balanga, the bay is
occupied, and the part is not there. Every write path refuses rather than
clamps, so a rejection can tell the operator "3 left" instead of "failed".

- Guarded conditional UPDATE inside SERIALIZABLE; the guard lives in the
  database, not in application logic a refactor could quietly remove
- StockMovement is an append-only ledger; StockLevel is the running total
  derived from it, so any figure on screen can be reconstructed
- StockLot carries a per-delivery DOT code, because Product.dotCode (one value
  per product) cannot express "20 tyres from March, 10 from August" — which
  made FIFO and any honest tyre-age campaign impossible
- Reservations are TTL-backed and grouped by booking or by walk-in name
- Postgres CHECK constraints enforce the invariant below the application, so a
  direct UPDATE cannot corrupt the running total
- Cycle counting, reorder suggestions, per-lot ageing, cost/margin for staff

INTEGRATION
Inventory hooks are dispatched from the booking state machine: reserve on
CONFIRMED, consume on COMPLETED, release on CANCELLED/NO_SHOW, expire on TTL.
Without these the stock system is a spreadsheet with extra steps.

SAFETY
- CSRF allowlist derived from NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL, never from the Host header
- costPrice and Product.notes never reach a non-staff payload
- 210 inventory tests pass; the concurrency suite proves the guarded statement
  returns zero rows on a decline, and asserts the naive implementation would
  fail the same schedules

Not yet verified: the CHECK constraints have never been executed against a live
database, and the concurrency suite models isolation rather than proving it.
Both are recorded in docs/inventory-decision-log.md.
